//Cors: Localhost origins belong in appsettings.Development.json only. This list is credentialed, so a localhost entry here makes anything bound to that port a trusted origin against the production admin API.
//Secrets: Intentionally empty — supply via environment variables or AWS Secrets Manager. Program.cs fails fast at startup if any are missing or still placeholders.
//Internal: WorkerSecret gates PUT /api/Internal/admins/promote, which grants SuperAdmin. It must never have a committed default.

Internal.//EnableSuperAdminBootstrap: Opens PUT /api/Internal/admins/promote, which grants SuperAdmin. Leave false. Set true for one deploy only when bootstrapping the very first SuperAdmin, then set it back.

Dynamo.//AutoCreateTables: Tables are provisioned by infrastructure, not by the app. Leaving this false keeps a ListTables call off every Lambda cold start and keeps dynamodb:CreateTable off the execution role.
Dynamo.//UsePublishedIndex: Reads published listings from PublishedStatus-index instead of scanning Properties. MUST stay false until every published row has been re-saved so it appears in the sparse index - see docs/data-backfill-required.md. Switching this on early empties the homepage.
